brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,-1) on level 0, all mutually adjacent in a compact cluster. Mesh check is clear. A fifth cell I placed early was removed.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Three pipe runs (run-1 through (0,1); run-2 through (1,0) and (0,0); run-3 through (1,-1)). Side connectors on the (0,0)|(0,1) and (0,0)|(1,-1) edges are meant to link them into one line, so all four cells carry a run. The configurator does not expose a continuity check, so the single connected pipe is inferred, not verified. No water inlet/port was added, since the brief did not name one.

requirements.requirement: Structure holds together as a build
requirements.evidence: Joint bolts at (0,0)-(1,-1), (0,1)-(0,0) and (0,0)-(1,0) lock the cells; check_build shows no LOOSE_BODY warnings and meshClash is clear. Only info-level OPEN_CAP_FACE notes remain; caps are optional and were not added.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell hex planter (cells at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,-1)) with three pipe runs and two side connectors meant to join them into one water line through every cell. Joint bolts lock the cluster, and check_build reports meshClash clear with no loose-body warnings. The pipe's full continuity and the lack of a water inlet are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: 3 runs IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
